response: A Murphy bed, also known as a wall bed, is a type of bed that is designed to be mounted on a wall and can be folded up vertically when not in use. This ingenious furniture solution is particularly popular in small spaces, such as apartments, studios, or rooms that need to serve multiple purposes. When the bed is not in use, it can be folded up and out of the way, freeing up the floor space for other activities or furniture. This makes it an ideal choice for maximizing space in compact living areas.
